title: I Tried to Qualify for the 2025 Seirawan Chess Championship
summary: He plays the arena qualifier for the 2025 Seirawan Chess Championship on chess.com (S-Chess): two extra pieces, the Hawk (bishop+knight) and the Elephant (rook+knight), start in hand and are gated onto the board when a back-rank piece first moves. First pairing is a national master; he wins many games (asks 'Did I win eight games?') in the arena (points-ordered standings).
rules: Standard setup plus, per side, a Hawk (bishop + knight) and an Elephant (rook + knight) held in reserve.
When a back-rank piece (incl. king/rook when castling) moves for the first time, you may place a reserve piece on the square it just vacated (gating). Otherwise the move is normal.
If all back-rank pieces have moved, unplaced reserve pieces can no longer enter ('you can run out of moves to actually place a piece').
Normal check/checkmate; arena tournament scoring (points standings).
